text: 1d We ran a full page New York Times ad to celebrate hitting $1B in revenue. And to thank our customers for their trust in us. 499 32 Comments Like Comment Share Saba Karim 8h Legendary stuff Like Reply Omair . 7h 🥇🥇🎉🎉🔥 Like Reply Lance Carr 20h Perhaps it is fitting that a bank celebrates the billion-dollar milestone. But I find the other number considerably more impressive: 450,000 people chose to trust you with their money. The billion is the financial consequence. The trust is the achievement. Interesting, perhaps, that even when banking changes, the milestones chosen as value remain oh so familiar. Like Reply Vidya Ramanathan 1d Congratulations to the whole team on crossing the billion-dollar line! Crossing this threshold without compromising on craft or customer alignment is a massive statement for modern banking. Like Reply David Torre 1d Crossing $1B in revenue is a real milestone for a bank built for startups, and thanking customers in print instead of a launch post is a nice touch. Which customer segment drove most of that growth, the very early founders or the companies that scaled on Mercury? Like Reply William Varma 1d Immad Akhund $1B is loud enough on its own. Using the moment to say thank you instead of chest-thumping makes the ad land even harder. Huge milestone. Like Reply 🌕 Oren B. 16h You're welcome Like Reply 1 Reaction Arthur Andrew Bavelas 1d Family Office Insights loves Mercury Like Reply 1 Reaction Fatima Rizwan 20h congratulations, that's a hug

author: garyvee
text:
When you are original, you aren’t afraid to take risks. You get in this place of “ I don’t give a fuck.”

Be thoughtful on whose judgment you decide to accept. Almost all judgment is someone imposing their insecurities on you.

This conversation with @doechii was in 2021 and watching her growth makes me so happy ❤️

If you’re creating something right now, ask yourself: am I making what I believe in, or only what I think people will approve of?
